projection_code_review.limits: Synthetic integer/byte projection only; no C, buffer, kernel, reachability or external protocol proof.

bounded_export_code_review.missing_header_behavior: saved missing receipt; no alternate source path
bounded_export_code_review.unseal_requires: both declaration freeze and parent contract freeze match; parent contract explicitly permits selected unseal

nonblocking_receipt_note: If an unexpected Git call fails before JSON command receipt is written, retain raw stdout/stderr and explicitly record the partially completed attempt; lack of final manifest is not evidence of zero calls.
